rogorn_attack_1.m: I had hoped it would not come to this. For the Shadow!

rogorn_completed_1.m: Thank you for listening to our side of the story.

rogorn_first_1.m: Look fellas, a kid! Out strolling here in the wilderness!

rogorn_first_2.m: Should you really be out here kid? These areas are dangerous.
r: You are right, I better leave.

rogorn_first_4.m: Well, west of here is not much. No towns for quite a while, only the harsh and dangerous wilderness.

rogorn_first_5.m: Of course, there is Carn Tower if you travel really far west, but you really do not want to head there.

rogorn_first_6.m: So, what brings you to these parts of the land?
r: I am looking for a group of men led by someone by the name of Rogorn. Are you him?
Just looking for any treasure that might reveal itself here.

rogorn_story_1.m: That depends, why do you want to know?
r: You are wanted by the Feygard patrol for the crimes you have committed.
I am seeking to deal justice wherever I can, and I heard that you are in need of being shown some justice.
I am sent by some guards over at the Crossroads guardhouse to look for you.
The guards from Feygard are looking for you, and I came to warn you.

rogorn_story_10.m: Law and order? What use do we have of that if we are always persecuted by them and do not even have the freedom to live our lives the way we want?

rogorn_story_11.m: They are always looking for us, trying to oppress us in some way. Always trying to make our lives a little bit harder.

rogorn_story_12.m: Good to hear that there still are some people willing to make a stand against Feygard. Let me tell you my side of the story.

rogorn_story_3.m: Justice? What would you know of justice, kid?

rogorn_story_4.m: If there is someone that deserves punishment, it surely isn't us. By the Shadow, it's those snobs from Feygard that should be taught a lesson.
r: I will not listen to your lies! For Feygard!
Talk all you want, I happen to know that you have stolen from Feygard, which is not acceptable.
What's your side of the story then?

rogorn_story_5.m: I tell you, we did not steal anything from those snobs.
r: You are still wanted dead by the Feygard patrol. For Feygard!
Why are they looking for you then?

rogorn_story_6.m: Talked to those guards from Feygard eh? Tell me, what is your opinion of Feygard?
r: They seem to have honorable ideals of law and order, and I respect that.
Their ideals seem to be a bit oppressive of the people, which I do not like.
I have no opinion, I try not to get involved in their business.

rogorn_story_7.m: Interesting. But now that you are part of their business by coming here to look for me on their behalf, how does that fit into your unwillingness to take sides?
r: I will not listen to your lies! For Feygard!
I was told that you have stolen from Feygard, which is not acceptable.
I want to hear your side of the story.
I am just looking to see if there is some treasure to be gained from this.

rogorn_story_8.m: You should make up your mind about what your priorities are. Tell your Feygard friends that we will not be oppressed by them. Shadow be with you, child.

rogorn_story_9.m: You have got that right. They are always trying to make life hard for us little people. Let me tell you my side of the story.

rogorn_story_r_1.m: Me and my boys here travelled from our home in Nor City to these northern lands a few days ago.

rogorn_story_r_10.m: You tell those guards that you searched for us, but did not find anyone.

rogorn_story_r_2.m: We had never been here ourselves. We had only heard stories about how tough the guards from Feygard were, and how they held their precious law above all.

rogorn_story_r_3.m: Anyway, we got wind of a certain business opportunity here up north. One where we would be on the receiving end of a very profitable deal.

rogorn_story_r_4.m: So we went here to conduct our business. Shortly thereafter, I guess the guards from Feygard must have been tipped off about us, since we noticed that we were being followed by the guards after a while.

rogorn_story_r_5.m: Not willing to risk anything, considering the rumors we had heard about the guards from there, we did the only reasonable thing we could do - we abandoned the plan right away and left, before we could conduct the business we had planned.

rogorn_story_r_6.m: However, something must have upset the guards there anyway. Now we hear that we are accused of murder and theft in Feygard, without even being there ourselves.
r: I will not listen to your lies! For Feygard!
Your story does not add up.
I believe your story. How can I help you?

rogorn_story_r_7.m: I can't really say. We do our business on behalf of Nor City, and our business is our own.
r: I will not listen to your lies! For Feygard!
Your story does not add up.
I believe your story. How can I help you?

rogorn_story_r_8.m: What are you, a spy for Feygard? I told you, the accusations against us are false.

rogorn_story_r_9.m: Thank you for listening to our side of the story.
r: What now? I was sent here to find you by some guards in the Crossroads guardhouse.
Can you tell me your side of the story again?
I will not listen to your lies! You must be held accountable for your crimes against Feygard!
I believe your story. How can I help you?

rogorn: The path is clear to me

rogorn.10: Minarra up in the tower at the Crossroads guardhouse has seen a band of rogues heading west from the guardhouse, towards Carn Tower. Minarra was sure they matched the description of some men whose heads have a bounty on them from the Feygard patrol. If these are the men that Minarra thinks, they are supposedly led by particularly ruthless savage named Rogorn.
rogorn.20: I am helping Minarra find the band of rogues. I should travel the road west from the Crossroads guardhouse towards Carn Tower and look for them. They have supposedly stolen three pieces of a valuable painting and are wanted dead for their crimes.
rogorn.21: Minarra also tells me that I should not trust anything I hear from them. In particular, anything from Rogorn should be viewed with great suspicion.
rogorn.30: I have found the band of rogues on the road west towards Carn Tower, led by Rogorn.
rogorn.35: Rogorn tells me that they are wrongly accused of murder and theft in Feygard, while they themselves have never even been to Feygard.
rogorn.40: I have decided to attack Rogorn and his band of rogues. I should return to Minarra with the three pieces of the painting once they are dead.
rogorn.45: I have decided not to attack Rogorn and his band of rogues, but instead report back to Minarra that she must have mistaken the men she saw for someone else.
rogorn.50: Minarra thanked me for dealing with the thieves, and told me that my services to Feygard will be appreciated.
rogorn.55: After telling Minarra that she must have mistaken the men for someone else, she seemed a bit suspicious, but thanked me for helping her look into the matter.
rogorn.60: I have helped Minarra with her task.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
